research_findings: Investigated a `localStorage` JSON parsing bug in `ultimate-sd/src/lib/session-storage.ts` where a single corrupted item could break the `getAllSessions` iteration because `try/catch` wrapped the entire loop.

Identified that fixing the bug by wrapping `JSON.parse` individually meant that removing corrupted items required carefully decrementing the loop index (`i--`), but a much cleaner and safer approach is to iterate backwards.
Identified that offline sessions were not surfaced in the profile dashboard, meaning users could lose track of unsubmitted practice data.
features_improved: Integrated the OfflineSessionsDashboard component directly into the profile page view to improve visibility.
new_features_added: Created the OfflineSessionsDashboard component to allow users to view, manage, and resume all their saved offline sessions from the user profile dashboard.
next_steps_for_next_run: Improve the offline sessions dashboard to allow bulk deletion.
Enhance the syncing logic to let users selectively sync offline sessions to the server when they sign in.
